raw_segments.text: I want a smoke, Jane, or a pinch of snuff to comfort me under all this.
Pour me Donner Yoon contentence, as Adele would say.
And unfortunately, I have neither my cigar case nor my snuff box.
It is your time now, little tyrant, but it will be mine presently.
And when once I have fairly seized you to have and to hold,
I'll just, figuratively speaking, attach you to a chain like this,
I'll wear you in my bosom, lest my jewel I should tine.
